profile.headline: Sr Software Engineer at Cotiviti
profile.geoLocationName: North Las Vegas, Nevada, United States
profile.summary: Over 21 years of strong and diverse experience as an IT professional.  I was responsible for the design and development of IT solutions to meet client requirements. I have demonstrated experience in all aspects of programming and design, including: producing specifications, coding, unit and system testing, as well as coordinating client user testing.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description: Programmer Analyst for the Enterprise Applications department projects.  I established guidelines and documentation templates for development projects.  Designed and developed custom web, WPF, Web API, and console applications for the Finance, Computing & Information Technology, MyCSN Technology Services, and Office of Technology Services departments to name a few.  These applications were comprised of Web Forms/Ajax Control Toolkit/JavaScript, MVC/JQuery/JavaScript/Bootstrap, SQL Server 2008, Entity Framework/LINQ To SQL, and ADO.NET.  Designed database tables, views, and stored procedures per application.  In addition, I assist with training/mentoring of team members.

positions.title: Contractor
positions.description: Contractor for the Clark County School District.  Developed and maintained web applications for the CIS web portal.  These applications were comprised of web forms/console/windows, JavaScript, Ajax Control Toolkit, and Oracle 9i.  Designed database tables, packages, and views.  Responsible for the conversion of production .NET applications to PHP utilizing JavaScript, and AJAX.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst, Intermediate
positions.description: Programmer Analyst for Clinical Applications projects.  Created Requirements and Functional Specification documents.  Provided maintenance and support of vendor medical records system in addition to internal software applications.  Designed and developed custom web applications using C#, VB.NET, SQL Server 2000, Oracle 9i, and Crystal Reports 10.  Designed database tables, views, stored procedures, and packages.

positions.title: Self-Employed
positions.description: Designed and developed web site for local gaming re-manufacturer that included database connectivity to display inventory online with photos of gaming equipment, administration screens, and email functionality.  Application was written using VB.NET and SQL Server database.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
Financial Vertical Project – Managed financial vertical product.  Developed Requirements and Functional Specification documents from information gathered during site visits to local credit unions and community banks.  Worked with other departments in the Division during construction and implementation of product.

Ingalls Healthcare Project – Managed Ingalls Healthcare System contract.  Worked with multiple departments in client’s organization to define data requirements to create ETL process.  Member of two-person installation team at customer location in Harvey, Illinois.  Documented ETL procedures for client and support.  Provided support for trainer.  Project made $100,000 profit.

The Pinehurst Corporation Project – Managed The Pinehurst Corporation implementation using Hospitality vertical product.  Coordinated project scheduling between client and internal resources.  Worked with client to define data requirements.  Developed ETL procedures using DataJunction software according to business rules.  Documented ETL procedures for support.  Installed system at client location in Pinehurst, North Carolina.  Created SOWs per client requests.

WestStar Credit Union Project – Managed WestStar Credit Union implementation using Financial vertical product.  Coordinated project scheduling between client and internal resources.  Worked with client to define data requirements.  Developed ETL procedures using DataJunction software according to business rules.  Documented ETL procedures for support.  Performed monthly imports. 

DataJunction 2002 Users Conference – Workshop speaker at the annual users conference in Austin, Texas.  

Pre-Sales Support – Transformed prospective client data using DataJunction software and loading into demo data marts. Developed the Needs Assessment Questionnaire (NAQ) template.  Worked with Development and Technical Services departments to setup additional demo and trial DM1 systems as requested.  Assisted at trade shows as technical advisor.

positions.title: Contractor
positions.description: Member of Integration Services team.  Responsible for upgrading external users of the Customer Resource Management Billing System to Y2K versions of the system.  Re-created and documented errors found during upgrade process.  Created program comparison reports using Access 97.  Provided one-on-one instruction of upgrade process to consultants and employees.  The system platform was both DOS and Windows based utilizing BTRIEVE and a MicroFocus Cobol front-end.

positions.title: Sr. Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Development Tracking System - Programmed production bug fixes, created two new reports and stored procedures, upgraded existing reports to Crystal 6.0, performed complete re-write of all existing report stored procedures, performed system tests, coordinated user acceptance tests, provided data conversion scripts to DBA, implemented system, provided support for released system. 

Senior Analyst and technical lead for the Franchise Development Tracking System Enhancements.  Created new reports using Crystal 6.0, created new report stored procedures, programmed 75% of the new requirements, and trained/mentored of new team members.  Provided support for system.

Senior Analyst and technical lead for Franchise Development Tracking System.  Responsible for Feasibility and Scope, requirements gathering, analysis and design to incorporate Object-Oriented 
methodology.  Data administration that included working with Data Administrator to design new data structure, provided all levels of test plans, data maps, customer interface, and the supervision of 6 consultants.  Created initial GUI screen prototypes.  Performed system tests.  Programmed bug fixes during testing process.  Co-wrote data conversion process using Access 97.  Provided support for system.  Insured new client/server system conformed to database and Microsoft design standards.

Senior Analyst for Express Development Tracking System.  Responsible for Feasibility and Scope, requirements gathering, writing stored procedures, lead system tester, code debugger, customer interface, and the supervision of 2 consultants. 

Technical lead for Payroll Year End processing.  Responsibilities included heavy customer and vendor interface, modifying IBM mainframe programs and JCL per user requirements, and system support.

All applications were comprised of MS SQL Server 6.0 with a Visual Basic 5.0 front-end and ODBC data access except for Franchise Tracking System which contained an RDO object wrapped around ODBC.

positions.title: Contractor
positions.description: Contractor for Application Support projects.  This involved providing maintenance and customer support for the ISI Payroll, Benefits, and PeopleSoft Human Resource systems.  Developed applications using COBOL II, DB2, and VSAM databases.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst II
positions.description:
Project Technical Lead for Hughes Aircraft Company's Central Material Inventory System.  Responsible for requirements gathering, manpower scheduling, project scheduling, estimating, and customer interface.  The system platform is an HP/3000 with an IMAGE database using COBOL programming language.

Member of Payroll System's maintenance team.  Responsible for providing maintenance and enhancement of Hughes Aircraft Company's ISI Payroll System.  Involved in the analysis, design, programming and testing of new and existing application systems.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst I
positions.description:
Quarterly System -- Assistant to project leader, developed new COBOL programs, test coordinator of new system, prepared production system JCL.  Analyzed, designed and made enhancements to the system to generate special tax data file and report for System Tax Service (STS).

Wage Attachment System -- Re-wrote the system by developing new COBOL programs, revised existing production programs, and supervised system and user acceptance tests.  Added new functionality to the system to process  new  wage attachment Gross-to-Net elements.  Developed on-line inquiry system screen using Application Productivity System (APS) screen painter and screen generator.
 
Subsidiary Payroll -- Project leader for implementation of two subsidiary systems. Analyzed user requirements to develop manpower plan, scheduling plan, and cost estimate for project.  Wrote new programs, modified existing programs, modified on-line inquiry system using APS, modified on-line transaction system using TRANSFORM (an IMS based software product).  Coordinated tests.  Completed projects ahead of schedule.

On-line Data Entry System -- Maintained PC based system using MicroFocus Workbench and Dialog system.  Performed modifications per user requests.  Installed new Network Data Mover (NDM) software to improve PC to mainframe communication of large data transfers. 

HR Savings Plan System -- Interfaced with Corporate HR Savings Plan customers to develop a user manual.

Other -- Wrote new programs as needed to provide ad hoc reports and special processing of data per user requests.  Consultant to other programmers.  Provided test cases, unit test modules, and performed system and user acceptance tests for various projects.  Prepared system documentation.
